title: Middle suprarenal arteries
summary: The middle suprarenal artery (middle capsular artery) is a paired artery in the abdomen.
It is a branch of the aorta.

sections.heading: Structure
paragraphs: The middle suprarenal artery arises from the aorta.

This is opposite the superior mesenteric artery.They pass laterally and slightly upward, over the crura of the diaphragm, to the suprarenal glands, where they anastomose with suprarenal branches of the inferior phrenic and renal arteries.

sections.heading: Function
paragraphs: The middle suprarenal artery supplies the adrenal gland.

sections.heading: Clinical significance
paragraphs: The middle suprarenal artery may be assessed using Doppler ultrasound.

sections.heading: History
paragraphs: The middle suprarenal artery may also be known as the middle adrenal artery, or the middle capsular artery.
